name: Scriptorum
description: A chamber of arcane scholarship where wizards transcribe, study, and refine their spellwork. Upgrading the Scriptorum unlocks deeper levels of card mastery.

tiers.description: Basic spell transcription. Cards can be refined to Stage 1: core improvements to damage, range, and cost.
Advanced scholarship. Cards can be specialized to Stage 2: push the top half or the bottom half further, shaping how your spell develops.

Master transcription. Cards can be brought to Stages 3 and 4: deep transformation of your spells into their final forms. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. Refinement: once each timeline, one card may bring both halves to their final stage. Dissemination: the spells granted to your arcane companions carry your best upgrades, and each companion's point budget rises by 3.

doctrines.name: Refinement
doctrines.description: A deep, precise deck. Once each timeline, one card takes a seventh upgrade point, for good: enough for both halves to reach Stage 4, where every other card must choose which half goes all the way.

doctrines.name: Dissemination
doctrines.description: Your study becomes the company's arsenal. The signature spells granted to arcane companions (Forces screen) carry the tiers of the guild's best upgraded copy instead of their printed strength, and each companion's point budget rises by 3.
